reasoning: Shows a pointing index finger next to a liquid droplet, which fits finger-prick blood tests (glucose monitoring, lancets), hand sanitizer or hand lotion tasks, and wet-touch settings. Because the drop and touch gesture are separate elements, it can be confused with generic water/hydration icons or simple tap/click actions.
